description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build and own agent infrastructure for an AI-driven services company. You will help make agents reliable in production, with durable context, trustworthy evaluations, and clear paths for human intervention.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and maintain infrastructure that helps agents execute tasks reliably across many iterations.

 - Design memory and retrieval systems that preserve useful context from messy operational data over time.

 - Develop evaluation harnesses that teams can use to make production deployment decisions.

 - Measure, test, troubleshoot, and improve agent systems, including failure recovery and retries.

 - Ship agent systems to customers and iterate based on production feedback.

 - Contribute across infrastructure, orchestration, customer collaboration, and team growth.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - At least 3 years of experience building and shipping LLM agents that ran unattended in production for real users.

 - Strong Python skills and hands-on experience building production systems.

 - Experience implementing agent memory and context retrieval for real operational data, not only demo datasets.

 - Experience building evaluation harnesses used to guide production deployment decisions.

 - Experience with agent orchestration, infrastructure, workflow management, or agent tooling.

 - Experience implementing production reliability patterns, including failure recovery and retry logic.

 - Evidence of technical ownership, such as taking a project from conception to production, founding or leading a technical project, or contributing to open-source agent tooling or LLM infrastructure.

 - Early engineering experience at a high-growth or AI-focused startup, experience building complex production systems, or a strong technical education background.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

$150,000 to $250,000 USD base salary, plus meaningful early equity. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, United States.
